slots.name: messageList
slots.description: The component that renders the message list.
slots.default: ScrollRoot (Base UI ScrollArea.Root wrapper); a styled 'div' in `ChatMessageList`

slots.name: messageListScroller
slots.description: The component that renders the message list scroller.
slots.default: ScrollViewport (Base UI ScrollArea.Viewport wrapper), or 'div' when `slots.messageList` is set; a styled 'div' in `ChatMessageList`

slots.name: messageListContent
slots.description: The component that renders the message list content.

slots.name: messageListOverlay
slots.description: The component that renders the message list overlay.

slots.name: messageListScrollbar
slots.description: The component that renders the message list scrollbar.
slots.default: ScrollScrollbar (Base UI ScrollArea.Scrollbar wrapper); not rendered when `slots.messageList` is set, as in `ChatMessageList`

slots.name: messageListScrollbarThumb
slots.description: The component that renders the message list scrollbar thumb.
slots.default: ScrollThumb (Base UI ScrollArea.Thumb wrapper); not rendered when `slots.messageList` is set, as in `ChatMessageList`

slots.name: messageListStatus
slots.description:
The visually-hidden `role="status"` element announcing streaming
transitions ("Assistant is responding" / "Response complete") to screen
readers. Pass `null`-rendering component to silence the announcements.
